content_sections.heading: District Police Kondagaon Bastar Fighter Constable Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The number of posts and the pay scale may be raised or reduced from time to time under instructions from the State Government and Police Headquarters, Nava Raipur. The former Agniveer reservation comes from the Chhattisgarh Government letter dated 14 October 2026. State Government rules and instructions apply to all reservation.

content_sections.heading: District Police Kondagaon Bastar Fighter Constable Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from local residents of Kondagaon district. Candidates must be not less than 18 years and not more than 28 years old on 1 January 2026. SC, ST and OBC candidates: upper age limit relaxed by up to 5 years. Local women candidates of Kondagaon district: upper age limit relaxable by up to 10 years, under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Special Provisions for Appointment of Women) Rules, 1997. Permanent government servants: not more than 36 years. Temporary post holders applying for another post: not more than 36 years. This also covers employees paid from contingency funds, work-charged employees and those working under a project implementation committee. Retrenched government servants: temporary service of up to 07 years may be deducted from their age, but the resulting age must not be more than three years above the upper age limit. These relaxations for present or former Chhattisgarh Government employees do not apply to anyone declared unfit for government service. All age relaxations are subject to State Government guidelines. 10th pass from a school located in Chhattisgarh or Madhya Pradesh. Scheduled Tribe candidates are eligible with Class 5 pass. Candidates of all categories from Naxal-affected families in the state, or from families living in relief camps in Naxal-affected areas, are eligible with Class 5 pass. The qualification must be held on the last date for submitting the form, and attaching the certificate is the applicant's own responsibility. All candidates measured for chest must show at least 5 cm of expansion. Women candidates are exempt from this requirement. The selection committee's decision on height and chest measurement is final. Candidates must not be physically disabled and must be medically fit. Knock-knee and flat-foot are not allowed. Candidates must have no eye disease and must be able to distinguish the main colours. The competent officer decides these cases by inspection and may consult the District Chief Medical Officer if needed. Third gender candidates follow the men's standards if their certificate states male and the women's standards if it states female. Producing this certificate is compulsory. See the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection takes place in stages. Document verification and physical measurement come first, followed by the tests below. Candidates get only one chance in each event and must take part in all of them. Unreserved candidates must score 60 percent of the 100 marks. SC, ST and OBC candidates must score 50 percent. A candidate unhappy with the assessment can appeal to the selection committee. The appeal is settled at once and the committee's decision is final. The paper covers general knowledge, intelligence, analytical ability, local geographical structure, culture, tradition, social values and arithmetic. Up to 15 times the number of advertised posts will be called, and all candidates with the same cut-off marks remain in the exam. The final list is made from the combined marks of the physical efficiency test, written test and interview, plus bonus marks.

faq.question: Q1. Can I send the form by ordinary post or courier?
faq.answer: No. A candidate applying by post must use registered post. The other option is to hand in the form at one of the four listed offices.

faq.question: Q2. Which certificate proves that I am a local resident?
faq.answer: Item 13 of the form asks for a certificate issued by a competent authority showing that you are a local resident of Kondagaon district.

faq.question: Q3. Can a Class 5 pass candidate from the OBC or general category apply?
faq.answer: Yes, if the candidate belongs to a Naxal-affected family or a family living in a relief camp in a Naxal-affected area. Otherwise, 10th pass is required unless the candidate is from the ST category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the highest age allowed for a government employee?
faq.answer: Permanent government servants and temporary post holders applying for another post must not be more than 36 years old.

faq.question: Q5. By what date must I hold my bonus mark certificates?
faq.answer: Licences and NCC or NSS certificates used for bonus marks must be held on the last date for submitting the form, which is 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Which part gives the most bonus marks?
faq.answer: Knowledge of the district's local dialect carries 20 of the 30 maximum bonus marks.

faq.question: Q7. Do I have to take part in every physical event?
faq.answer: Yes. All five events are compulsory, so a candidate must attempt the long jump, high jump, shot put and both races.

faq.question: Q8. Does submitting the form confirm that I am eligible?
faq.answer: No. Applying does not establish eligibility, and the selection committee's decision on eligibility is final and binding.
